# =====================================================
# Identifying Weather Events. Processing Script
# Functionality: Florencia Sangermano
# Development: The functionality of this script was designed by the author with code generated through instructions provided to Copilot AI.
# =====================================================

import tensorflow as tf
import tensorflow_hub as hub
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import os
import librosa
import soundfile as sf
import gc

# =====================================================
# LOAD YAMNET
# =====================================================

print("Loading YAMNet...")

yamnet_model = hub.load("https://tfhub.dev/google/yamnet/1")

class_map_path = tf.keras.utils.get_file(
    "yamnet_class_map.csv",
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tensorflow/models/master/research/audioset/yamnet/yamnet_class_map.csv"
)

class_names = [
    line.strip().split(",")[2]
    for line in open(class_map_path).readlines()[1:]
]

print(f"Loaded {len(class_names)} classes")

# =====================================================
# WEATHER CLASSES
# =====================================================

weather_keywords = [
    "Rain",
    "Rain on surface",
    "Raindrop",
    "Wind",
    "Wind noise (microphone)"
]

# =====================================================
# INPUT / OUTPUT
# =====================================================

audio_folder = r"D:/Flor/SaudiArabia/Data/WavsChannel60"
output_csv = r"D:/Flor/SaudiArabia/YamnetResults/weather_labels_summary.csv"

# =====================================================
# FIND WAV FILES
# =====================================================

wav_files = []

for root, _, files in os.walk(audio_folder):
    for file in files:
        if file.lower().endswith(".wav"):
            wav_files.append(os.path.join(root, file))

print(f"Found {len(wav_files)} wav files")

# =====================================================
# RESUME FROM PREVIOUS RUN
# =====================================================

if os.path.exists(output_csv):
    processed = set(pd.read_csv(output_csv, usecols=["Filename"])["Filename"])
    print(f"Found {len(processed)} previously processed files")
else:
    processed = set()

first_write = not os.path.exists(output_csv)

# =====================================================
# PROCESS FILES
# =====================================================

for i, filepath in enumerate(wav_files):

    if filepath in processed:
        continue

    try:
        print(f"\nProcessing {i+1}/{len(wav_files)}")
        print(os.path.basename(filepath))

        # READ AUDIO
        wav_data, sr = sf.read(filepath)

        # Convert stereo to mono
        if len(wav_data.shape) > 1:
            wav_data = np.mean(wav_data, axis=1)

        # Resample to 16 kHz
        if sr != 16000:
            wav_data = librosa.resample(wav_data, orig_sr=sr, target_sr=16000)
            sr = 16000

        # RUN YAMNET
        scores, embeddings, spectrogram = yamnet_model(wav_data)
        scores_np = scores.numpy()

        # CLASSIFICATION OF EACH CHUNK
        chunk_labels = np.argmax(scores_np, axis=1)
        detected_labels = [class_names[idx] for idx in chunk_labels]
        total_chunks = len(chunk_labels)

        # WEATHER SUMMARY
        weather_labels = [label for label in detected_labels if label in weather_keywords]
        weather_chunk_count = len(weather_labels)
        weather_percent = round(100 * weather_chunk_count / total_chunks, 2)

        weather_types = sorted(set(weather_labels))
        weather_summary = "NONE" if len(weather_types) == 0 else "; ".join(weather_types)

        # OUTPUT ROW (ONLY WEATHER SUMMARY)
        row = {
            "Filename": filepath,
            "WeatherClasses": weather_summary,
            "WeatherChunkCount": weather_chunk_count,
            "WeatherPercent": weather_percent,
            "TotalChunks": total_chunks
        }

        # WRITE ROW
        pd.DataFrame([row]).to_csv(
            output_csv,
            mode="a",
            header=first_write,
            index=False
        )

        first_write = False
        processed.add(filepath)

        # CLEAN MEMORY
        del wav_data, scores, embeddings, spectrogram
        del scores_np, chunk_labels, detected_labels, row
        gc.collect()

        if len(processed) % 100 == 0:
            print(f"Processed {len(processed)} files")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\nERROR: {os.path.basename(filepath)}")
        print(str(e))
        continue

print("\n✅ ALL FILES COMPLETED")
print(f"\nOutput saved to:\n{output_csv}")
